== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Light Repeating Blaster Rifle, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 16 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
